speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: The Ministry of Communications and Information (MCI) seeks to enhance opportunities, sustain trust and strengthen our communities to reap the full benefits of digital and technological advances, while mitigating the potential harms.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: These efforts to enhance digital infrastructure and encourage innovation are the foundation for our businesses and people to thrive in a digital age.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI will scale adoption of digital utilities that support core business functions, such as e-payment and e-invoicing.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also work with partners to shape international rules, benchmarks, and norms, through Digital Economy Agreements and other initiatives.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI will continue to help Singaporeans raise their digital proficiencies, both to access digital services and navigate confidently online, as well as to access good opportunities in tech.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Initiatives under the Information and Communications Jobs Transformation Map will equip tech workers with the tools to stay competitive.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also help workers, both within the information and communications sector and across the economy, upskill and deepen their proficiencies in high-demand areas such as 5G, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: As part of the Forward Singapore exercise, we will work with the Ministry of Manpower and Ministry of Education, as well as industry partners, to ensure that good opportunities remain accessible to all, through initiatives such as the TechSkills Accelerator for ITE and Polytechnics Alliance.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Trust among our people, and in our institutions and systems, is essential to the continued vitality and resilience of our society and economy.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI takes a comprehensive approach to building and strengthening trust.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI, together with partners from industry, academia, and the community, will grow the digital, information, and media literacy of Singaporeans, and promote better social cohesion, wellness, and health outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI will continue to coordinate Whole-of-Government public communications on major national issues to ensure that the public receives timely and accurate information.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI will also support efforts to protect public interest and trust by providing the public with a reliable source for facts, addressing misperceptions, and alerting the public to scams and other threats.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI is committed to building and strengthening our Singapore communities in both offline and online spaces.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will continue to provide timely, accessible, and inclusive Government communications, through in-person engagements as well as traditional and digital media platforms, to reach Singaporeans from all walks of life.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: We will also engage the community through REACH, to better understand stakeholders’ views, needs, and aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: All Singaporeans should be able to participate meaningfully in society and reap the benefits of digital technologies, regardless of ability or personal circumstances.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: Access to credible sources of information and content that reflect our Singapore voice and values is vital to our social cohesion, cultural heritage, and national identity.

speaker: The Minister for Communications and Information (Mrs Josephine Teo)
text: MCI is committed to doing our part, alongside the public and our partners, to meet the challenges ahead and build a thriving digital future for all.
